Judge scope conformance for PR #81 (feature/sfcc-731-pdp-gallery -> develop) against Jira story SFCC-731.

CONTEXT YOU NEED (already verified, don't re-derive):

SFCC-731 ("pdp/gallery", Code Review, assignee Tim Lavelle) description: "As a Developer, I want a reusable pdp/gallery React component built to the Zimmermann Design System 2026 spec, so that it can be consumed by pdp/hero to render the product image and video gallery on the PDP. The component renders a sequence of media items (photo and video) in a stacked layout on desktop and a swipeable carousel on mobile. The desktop layout adapts based on total media count. Video is treated as a standard media item and slots into the layout based on its position in the product's media array. The component renders a View Gallery button as a trigger only — the gallery overlay is a separate component and out of scope for this story."

Related tickets and how they interact with this PR's diff:
- SFCC-186 "PDP – Product Image Gallery": near-duplicate summary/description of SFCC-731, same assignee, same "Code Review" status. SFCC-186 formally BLOCKS SFCC-731 in Jira's link graph but is not resolved. Likely an old-style ticket superseded by SFCC-731's component-epic decomposition — probably not a PR defect, just Jira hygiene, but confirm the diff doesn't contradict SFCC-186's own description (e.g. "Video content within the gallery is out of scope — see SFCC-188" — matches SFCC-731's approach of treating video as a positional slot only).
- SFCC-187 "PDP – Image Gallery Open State" (Blocked, assignee Jasmijn Tsang, labels DesignDependent): this is the full-screen "expanded state" gallery overlay. SFCC-731's own description explicitly excludes this. BUT a comment from Jasmijn Tsang (reporter/BA) on SFCC-187, dated 2026-09-04: "Apologies, I have had to rewrite the ACs / take out a few ACs as they belong to the component story, covered in SFCC-731. Also, on colour variants, still pending business examples, the ACs needed to be adjusted, to be consistent with the default gallery state." This is a BA-sanctioned re-scope: SOME of SFCC-187's ACs (the ones belonging to "the component story") were moved into SFCC-731. The old ACs listed in that comment (now struck through) covered: full-screen overlay open/close, colour-variant swatches inside the overlay pre-selecting the PDP's selected colour and updating without reload, thumbnail strip navigation, scroll-to-navigate, pinch-to-zoom on mobile, focus return to PDP scroll position on close. SFCC-187 remains status=Blocked as of today (updated 2026-09-07), not closed or reduced.
- PR #81 DOES implement a full gallery overlay (`ZimmGalleryOverlay`, new organism, 341 lines + 184-line recipe + 233-line test + 119-line stories) including colour-swatch selection reusing `ZimmColourSwatchGroup`, thumbnail navigation, keyboard access, close-and-restore-focus. Your job: determine whether the overlay work actually implemented in the diff matches ONLY the ACs the BA comment said now belong to SFCC-731 (in which case it's correctly in-scope, not creep), or whether it goes further than what that comment sanctioned — e.g. the comment explicitly flagged "colour variants, still pending business examples" as unresolved, yet the PR shipped specific colour-variant UX in the overlay (single colour shows "Colour: <name>", 2+ colours show "Also available in" via a new Contentful uiCopy key `pdp.gallery_overlay.colourLabel"). Is that colour-variant implementation covered by "consistent with the default gallery state" (i.e. just reusing the already-built PDP pattern, low risk) or does it look like the team guessed at still-pending business examples? Also check whether pinch-to-zoom (explicitly in SFCC-187's old ACs) was implemented anywhere — if not, is that a real gap in what the PR claims to deliver, or legitimately still out of scope?
- SFCC-723 "pdp/hero" (Blocked, assignee Kiera Rikard-Bell): "top-level orchestration component for the PDP, composing the pdp/gallery and pdp/product-content into a single, responsive hero layout... layout and composition only... The sole configuration prop is `showGalleryButton`." PR #81's own description says it "Fixes the PDP hero to bleed full-width per the confirmed Figma spec" — activates `PageContainer`, corrects `ProductView`'s column gap/content-column width to 180px/218px/140px, cancels the sitewide `#app-main` grid margin locally, aligns breakpoints. This is hero-level orchestration/layout work that reads as SFCC-723's own stated scope, done inside SFCC-731's PR while SFCC-723 sits Blocked and assigned to someone else. As of TODAY (2026-09-07), SFCC-723 has an unanswered comment from BA Hazel Cacalda asking Kiera to confirm whether the Figma link on that ticket is "the final approved version" — i.e. there's no confirmed record of hero-layout sign-off on SFCC-723's own ticket, even though PR #81's commits assert "confirmed Figma spec" for this same layout work. Determine: does the PR's hero-layout scope go beyond "the minimum plumbing SFCC-731's gallery needs to render at the right size" (defensible, since a real bug — #app-main not stretching — was starving the gallery to 0 width) into "building SFCC-723's actual deliverable" (overreach)? Look at the actual diff for `product-view/index.tsx`, `pageContainer/index.tsx`, and `theme/globalStyles.ts` to judge this rather than taking the PR description's framing at face value.
- SFCC-737 "pdp/product-content" (In Progress, assignee Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz): "composition container... layout, ordering, and rendering of all child elements within the panel, and the static content elements (product name, description, model description, style code)." PR #81 modifies `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` heavily (265 additions, 236 deletions) — check whether these changes are strictly "make room for / integrate the new gallery" (in-scope for 731) or whether they reach into product-content panel layout/ordering territory that's SFCC-737's stated scope (over-scope, and worth flagging that another dev, Jhoan, is actively working SFCC-737 right now — a collision risk if her in-progress branch touches the same file).
- SFCC-708 "PDP – Related Colours Attribute" (In QA, assignee Krizel Bartolome): PR #81 consumes `c_relatedSwatches`/`buildRelatedSwatches` (already merged to develop) — this looks like correct reuse, not reimplementation. Low concern, but confirm the diff doesn't duplicate logic SFCC-708 already owns.
- SFCC-188 "PDP – Product Video in Gallery" (Blocked): PR #81 correctly treats video as a positional slot with no real data source — matches SFCC-188 being blocked. This looks correctly deferred, not a gap.

FILES CHANGED (34 total, +3281/-475) — get the full list and diff yourself via `gh pr diff 81` or the local worktree at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-marcel-a-n-navarro-Dev-zimmermann-pwa/37973080-8be5-46e1-9aab-e2abcb81ea17/scratchpad/pr81-head (already checked out at the PR's head commit, node_modules symlinked, ready to run/read). Base commit for diffing: 4cdfb47f324ce533079345ab7aa1203e4a5af734 (also checked out at ../pr81-base). Do not re-run tsc/lint/test/audit:tokens — already measured clean on both branches with zero regressions, that's settled.

YOUR TASK: Territory-map the changed files/hunks to SFCC-731 vs SFCC-186 vs SFCC-187 vs SFCC-723 vs SFCC-737, using the diff itself as evidence, not the PR description's own framing. Give an explicit verdict: does PR #81 deliver SFCC-731 exactly, under-deliver anything (missing AC), or over-deliver into neighbouring blocked/in-progress tickets? For any over-delivery, state which ticket's territory it is and how confident you are, citing file:line. This is going to a human FED lead for adjudication — he needs the file-level evidence, not just a restatement of the tickets.

## Scope verdict: PR #81 (feature/sfcc-731-pdp-gallery → develop) vs SFCC-731

Verified against the real diff (`4cdfb47f..HEAD`, checked out at the worktrees, 34 files / +3281/-475), not the PR's own commit-message framing. Where a raw diff stat looked alarming, I re-diffed with `--ignore-all-space` to separate real logic changes from re-indentation noise.

### Territory map — clean

- **SFCC-186** (near-duplicate ticket): no contradiction. Video is still positional-only (`zimmMediaTile/index.tsx:72-73`: *"No real playback source yet... ready for SFCC-188 to wire a real `<video>`/Vimeo source behind"*).
- **SFCC-708** (related-colour swatches): correctly reused, not duplicated — both `product-view/index.tsx` and `product-detail/index.tsx` import `buildRelatedSwatches` from the existing `productInfo.ts`, no reimplementation.
- **SFCC-188** (video in gallery): correctly deferred, matches its Blocked status.
- **SFCC-737** (`pdp/product-content`): **not actually touched.** `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` shows 501 changed lines in `git diff`, but `git diff --ignore-all-space` collapses that to ~40 real lines: a new `PageContainer` import/wrap (two calls, `boxed={false}` for the hero, `boxed={true}` for recommendations), an `H1` content change, and a constant rename. The rest is pure re-indent from the new wrapper element. No reordering of name/description/model-info/style-code, no accordion changes. The suspected collision with Jhoan's in-progress SFCC-737 branch does not materialize in this diff.
- **SFCC-91 `ui-kits` atoms** (`zimmButton`, `zimmColourSwatch`, `zimmColourSwatchGroup`): additive, backward-compatible extensions only (`variant?: 'square'|'circle'`, `appendColon?`, `sx?` passthrough) — existing `square`/PDP styling is preserved byte-for-byte inside a new conditional branch, not altered. Legitimate reuse to support the overlay, not a rewrite.
- `.claude/registry/*.md` — mechanical auto-regen churn, not a finding, per instructions.
- No Tier 1 file touched anywhere in the 34-file list.

### Finding 1 — OVER-delivery into SFCC-723 ("pdp/hero") territory — HIGH confidence

SFCC-723 is Blocked, assigned to Kiera Rikard-Bell, and its own BA (Hazel Cacalda) has an **unanswered** question on the ticket asking whether its Figma link is even final. Despite that, this PR implements SFCC-723's literal job description — *"composing the pdp/gallery and pdp/product-content into a single, responsive hero layout"* — with Figma node IDs cited directly in the code:

- `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:771` — `// SFCC-731 — 140px right / 40px bottom, per Figma "pdp/hero" (node 7932:45339).` applied to `ProductView`'s outer wrapper.
- `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:798` — `// SFCC-731 — 180px gap between gallery/content at lg+, 32px stacked below.`
- `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:860-890` — the content column pinned to a fixed `width={['100%','100%','100%','218px']}` (+ matching `flexBasis`/`flexShrink`/`flexGrow`/`paddingX`), cited against *"PDP hero content column, node 40000307:14476."*
- `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:951-953,1157` — the whole hero section pulled out of `PageContainer`'s uniform page-level containment (full-bleed + negative-margin cancellation of the sitewide `#app-main` padding) specifically to hand spacing control to the values above.

I distinguish this from two genuinely defensible bug fixes that I do **not** flag: `overrides/app/theme/globalStyles.ts:228-235` (`zimmAppMain`'s `width: '100%'`) and `overrides/app/components/pageContainer/index.tsx:26-30` (`width: 'auto'` vs `'100%'`) — both are real, narrow, one-property fixes to a pre-existing `#app-main`-collapses-to-0-width bug that would otherwise block the gallery from rendering at all. A gallery with `flex={1}` doesn't need its sibling pinned to exactly 218px or the outer wrapper padded to exactly 140/40 to render — those precise, Figma-hero-frame-matched values only serve pixel-parity with SFCC-723's own frame, not "the gallery doesn't collapse." This is implemented ahead of, and independent of, SFCC-723's own confirmation state.

### Finding 2 — UNDER-delivery: pinch-to-zoom (PRD-061) — HIGH confidence

`.docs/prd/pdp.md:178` — **PRD-061 (confirmed):** *"Pinch-to-zoom and swipe-to-advance gallery navigation — mobile and touch."* Swipe-to-advance is delivered (native scroll-snap in `ZimmProductGallery`'s compact carousel). Pinch-to-zoom is not implemented anywhere in `zimmProductGallery/` or `zimmGalleryOverlay/` — no gesture handling of any kind — and it is not flagged anywhere as a deliberate, deferred gap (no doc comment, no story, no test), unlike this codebase's normal practice of recording known gaps explicitly. This item is also named verbatim in Jasmijn's 2026-09-04 comment as one of the SFCC-187 ACs that moved into SFCC-731 alongside the rest of the overlay work the PR did build. Since the PR built everything else on that list (open/close, thumbnail nav, scroll-to-navigate, focus/scroll restore), silently dropping this one item is a real, named gap, not an out-of-scope call the story text supports.
